title: Indoor South Florida Plans for Oct. 9 to 11
igCaption:
Indoor weekend plans for Oct. 9 to 11 include a reopened South Beach hotel, a new Miami residence, comedy, nightlife, and Black Violin in Fort Lauderdale.
Black Violin plays Sunday at 7 p.m., with tickets from $23 to $105.
Which one would you actually do this weekend?

Sources: The Real Deal, Haute Living, Eventbrite, Miami New Times

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #WeekendPlans

scenes.text: Need indoor plans for October nine to eleven? South Florida has a reopened hotel, a new opening, comedy, nightlife, and Black Violin.
In South Beach, Safe Harbor is reopening the renovated Art Deco Tides Hotel after nearly a decade. The hotel is back on Ocean Drive this weekend.
scenes.caption: In South Beach, Safe Harbor is reopening the renovated Art Deco Tides Hotel after nearly a decade. The hotel is back on Ocean Drive this weekend.

scenes.text: In Miami, Casa Bella Residences opens with B&B Italia Design and interiors by Piero Lissoni. It adds another new residential opening to the weekend list.
scenes.caption: In Miami, Casa Bella Residences opens with B&B Italia Design and interiors by Piero Lissoni. It adds another new residential opening to the weekend list.

scenes.text: Palm Beach Improv has free tickets listed for Friday, October ninth. That gives Palm Beach County one easy comedy option. If you go, open NEAR and see who else was there.

scenes.text: On South Beach, Ultra White Miami marks its five year anniversary Friday night. The all white event runs from nine p.m. to three a.m.
scenes.caption: On South Beach, Ultra White Miami marks its 5-year anniversary Friday night. The all-white event runs from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m.

scenes.text: Sunday in Fort Lauderdale, Black Violin plays the Broward Center at seven p.m. Wil Baptiste and Kev Marcus bring the Be Free Tour home, with Braxton Cook opening. Tickets run from twenty-three to one hundred five dollars.
